author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Ninety-Three! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Crafted for people in the kitbashing world of #28, DAGA is a miniature acgnostic dice-scaling stats game useing any models you want in any hightened-reality setting.  Let's check it out!

Check out the the game rules  HERE: https://rossocinquegames.itch.io/
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 093 - DAGA by Rosso Cinque Games
